name: anchor: acknowledge and apologize
utterance: I'm so sorry you've been waiting over an hour, and getting mixed messages about the labs on top of that is really frustrating.

name: paraphrase: acknowledge and apologize
utterance: Sitting out there that long after being told the wrong thing would make anyone angry. I apologize.

name: anchor: clarify the misunderstanding
utterance: Can you tell me what you were told when you booked today? It sounds like the lab order and this visit got scheduled in the wrong order.

name: anchor: collaborative problem-solving
utterance: Let's figure out what we can still get done today. I can order your labs now and the lab downstairs can draw them before you leave.

name: anchor: reset expectations
utterance: Today's visit was meant to go over lab results, which we don't have yet. We can't review them today, but next you'll get the labs done and then come back to go over them.

name: anchor: offer control
utterance: It's your call. Do you want to use today's time for anything else on your mind, or would you rather head out?

name: anchor: calm verbal communication
utterance: Go ahead, I'm listening. Take all the time you need, I won't cut you off.

name: anchor: generic reassurance
utterance: Don't worry, we'll figure it out.

name: anchor: redirect to medical history
utterance: Okay. So what medications are you currently taking?

name: near-miss: history after the wait is addressed is not a redirect
utterance: Now that we've got the labs sorted out, can I ask about the medications you take?

name: anchor: defensive response
utterance: We're really busy today, everyone in that waiting room has been here a while.

name: near-miss: owning the delay is an apology, not defensive
utterance: I know we're running behind today, and I'm sorry. That's on us, not you.

name: anchor: blame the patient
utterance: The instructions said to get your labs drawn before this visit, so you should have done that.

name: anchor: blame other staff
utterance: Honestly, the front desk messed this up. They scheduled you wrong.

name: near-miss: neutral explanation is not blaming staff
utterance: It looks like the lab order got entered for after your visit instead of before. Nobody's fault, it just got crossed.

name: anchor: dismiss/minimize
utterance: It's only been an hour, there's no reason to be this upset.

name: anchor: authoritative tone
utterance: Sir, you need to calm down right now.

name: combination: dismiss + authoritative
utterance: Relax, it's just an hour. Let's get on with it.

name: near-miss: conditional security threat is not removal
utterance: If you keep raising your voice, we may have to get security involved.

name: end: security removal directed
utterance: I'm going to ask security to come and walk you out.

name: combination: apologize + collaborate
utterance: I'm really sorry about the wait and the mix-up. Let me put the lab order in right now so you can get drawn before you leave.

name: combination: clarify + reset
utterance: What were you told this visit was for? Usually the labs happen first and this visit is where we go over the results, so we can't do that part today.

name: neutral: small talk scores nothing
utterance: Is it still raining out there?

name: neutral: politeness alone scores nothing
utterance: Thanks for your patience.
